ValidationRule.description: To assign a case to fixed prices department, the case must be related to an account that is not BBVA Internal Contact.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = "SER_Fixed_Data", OR ( ISBLANK(AccountId), Account.Name = "BBVA Internal Contact" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To assign a case to fixed prices department, the case must be related to an account that is not BBVA Internal Contact.
